text:
lia: Heads up — Azure partner asked for a compact "inference-starter" that bundles: Terraform modules (network, aks/vmss, storage + kms), a tiny demo app (healthcheck + curlable endpoint), and a marketplace packaging guide. I opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-starters/pull/42. Can we do a quick sync on ownership + testing matrix today? @alex @sophia

alex: Seen the PR, looks like a good start. Quick q: do we include a managed identity example for key access, or just use service principals?

lia: Prefer managed identity for Azure docs, but keep a SP example in a separate example folder. Need to call out limitations (user-assigned vs system).

sophia: Agreed on MI. I'll add explicit module inputs: model_bucket_name, kms_key_arn (or key_id for Azure), allowed_instance_types (list), and enable_managed_identity (bool). I'll also stub Terratest cases that run deploy -> curl -> destroy.

kevin: I'll wire up CI to run the plan/apply smoke matrix. Proposed matrix: eastus2/gov-west-1 + Standard_NC/Standard_NV (arm64 + x86), plus a minimal e2e with tiny container that returns 200. Anything else?

lia: Add a checklist for marketplace packaging: SKU mapping, pricing metadata, ARM64/Graviton parity note, and a small section on networking (NAT egress for pull, private endpoints for model artifacts).

matt: For the docs, let's include a one-page quickstart that shows the absolute-min terraform invocation. Something like:

```
module "redwood_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-starters//modules/inference"
  name   = "demo-inference"
  region = "eastus2"
  instance_types = ["Standard_NC6", "Standard_NC12"]
  model_artifact_bucket = "redwood-demo-models"
  enable_managed_identity = true
}
```

matt: That snippet will sit in QUICKSTART.md, not in the root README. Keep README focused on architecture diagrams + security considerations.

marketplace-bot: Created ticket INF-848 in Jira: "partner-starters: marketplace packaging + test matrix" assigned to lia, alex.

alex: One more ask — include a short troubleshooting section for common terraform hiccups (role assignment propagation, Azure quota errors). I can draft that.

lia: Perfect. Action items: sophia -> add module inputs + terratest stubs; kevin -> CI matrix; alex -> troubleshooting doc; matt -> quickstart + diagrams; lia -> marketplace checklist + finalize PR. Target end-of-week for initial merge and partner review. :thumbsup:

sophia: I'll also add a tiny script under examples/ci/smoke.sh that runs the healthcheck container and validates the /health endpoint. Will link it in the PR.

kevin: I'll draft the GH Action that spawns ephemeral infra and tears down after 20m. Will add cost-guard labels.

lia: Thanks all — if anyone hits blocking questions ping me in thread or drop into my calendar for a 15m sync.

alex: cool, sounds good. :rocket:
